method: Complete original printed pages and Series A final-key cells visually compared; repaired text and option order checked in a second pass.

records.text: BRICS leaders signed the agreement to establish a New Development Bank at the summit held in:
Which one of the following statements is not correct?

options.B: India submitted a formal application for membership of the NSG in 2016.
options.C: India proposed the Comprehensive Convention on International Terrorism in 1996.
options.D: The Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting (CHOGM) was held in 2016 at Malta.

records.text: Which one of the following statements in respect of the States of India is not correct?

options.A: States in India cannot have their own Constitutions.
options.B: The State of Jammu and Kashmir has its own Constitution.
options.C: States in India do not have the right to secede from the Union of India.
options.D: The maximum number of members in the Council of Ministers of Delhi can be 15 percent of the total number of members in the Legislative Assembly.

records.text: Which one of the following statements is correct?

options.A: In India, the same person cannot be appointed as Governor for two or more States at the same time.
options.B: The Judges of the High Court of the States in India are appointed by the Governor of the State just as the Judges of the Supreme Court are appointed by the President.
options.C: No procedure has been laid down in the Constitution of India for the removal of a Governor from his/her post.
options.D: In the case of a Union Territory having a legislative setup, the Chief Minister is appointed by the Lt. Governor on the basis of majority support.

records.text:
Consider the following:
1. Bats
2. Bears
3. Rodents
The phenomenon of hibernation can be observed in which of the above kinds of animals?

options.D: Hibernation cannot be observed in any of the above
